facts: Enfield, Havering and Lambeth official services publish query-capable FeatureServer roots
Each relevant borough service publishes EPSG:27700 spatial metadata
Candidate BNG coordinates are therefore suitable inputs for a future exact same-CRS point query
The acceptance gate requires the intended target layer to be identified explicitly
The acceptance gate requires a candidate point geometry bound to the exact canonical row
A spatial-intersection result must come from an actual server response or authoritative polygon analysis
An empty result can be accepted only when an actual query response proves it, not when the client fails
A positive result must preserve source layer identity and returned feature identity before scoring
CRS, candidate row and layer identity must all be recorded with the result
Until those acceptance conditions are met, exact borough-confirmed future-growth binding remains zero
